request: Great Wall traps run: play the Great Wall from the start through to the T-Rex. Please SET OFF the traps instead of dodging them perfectly: step on crumbling floor tiles and let them fall, let a couple of darts hit you, run past the spinning/sliding blades and the wall blades (getting nicked is fine), let a boulder roll at you (jump it if you can), walk slowly over spikes, ride the zipline, and shoot the crows. Use medipacks when needed but don't reload a save. At the end, let the T-Rex chase you a while; getting eaten is fine. Press F12 when you're done.
